题目.题目1:
【听力】听录音，回答问题：说话人觉得自己的小镇怎么样？
听：In comparison with Shanghai, our town is very quiet.
A. 比上海热闹
B. 和上海一样
C. 比上海安静
D. 比上海大
题目.题目2:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：Let's make a ______ between the two plans.
A. compare
B. comparable
C. comparison
D. comparative
题目.题目3:
【选词填空】从 comparison、compare 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
题干：Don't ______ me with my sister!
考点：词性转换
题目.题目4:
【适当形式填空】用所给单词的适当形式填空。
题干：The teacher ______ the two essays yesterday. (comparison)
考点：词性转换
题目.题目5:
【改错】句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
题干：There are many comparison in this report.
考点：变形
题目.题目6:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干："There's no comparison" means ______.
A. they are the same
B. we can't find them
C. nobody knows
D. one is much better than the other
考点：短语
题目.题目7:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干："In comparison with" means about the same as ______.
A. instead of
B. because of
C. as well as
D. compared with
考点：用法
题目.答案:
【1】C（比上海安静）
讲解：in comparison with 和……相比。
【2】C（comparison）
讲解：make a comparison 做比较，要名词。
【3】compare
讲解：don't 后面要动词 compare。
【4】compared
讲解：yesterday 用动词 compare 的过去式。
【5】comparison → comparisons
讲解：many 后面用复数。
【6】D（one is much better than the other）
讲解：There's no comparison. 根本没法比（一方好得多）。
【7】D（compared with）
讲解：in comparison with = compared with。
